title: Zacchaeus in the Sycamore Tree
description: Zacchaeus, a rich chief tax collector in Jericho, climbs up into a sycamore-fig tree to see Jesus because he is short in stature. Jesus sees him and says he must stay at his house today. The crowd grumbles that Jesus has gone to be the guest of a sinner, but Zacchaeus promises to give half of his possessions to the poor and repay four times the amount to anyone he has cheated. Jesus declares that salvation has come to this house, because he too is a son of Abraham.
